messages:
eva: Heads-up — sample-app embed flow is failing in CI. Curl with return_raw_metadata=true returns metadata, but JS SDK call returns none and CI shows duplicate indexing jobs.

mike: quick repro?

eva: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{\"inputs\":[\"x\"], \"return_raw_metadata\": true}'
```
responds 200 with metadata[].

harper: sdk snippet used in sample-app (js-sdk 1.10.0):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1', inputs: ['x'], returnRawMetadata: true });
```
no metadata, then logs show queue ids job_q_42 then job_q_43.

mike: two problems then: 1) param mapping (camelCase not being translated to snake_case) and 2) retry semantics: REST may return 202 + Location when metadata backend is slow; SDK currently treats non-200 as retryable and replays, causing duplicates.

eva: agreed. CI trace attached: single upstream 202 -> queued job, then SDK retried and enqueued again.

harper: plan: add explicit alias mapping returnRawMetadata -> return_raw_metadata in js-sdk, add unit for param mapper, and update embeddings.create retry policy so 202 is considered accepted/terminal for that route. Also add an e2e in sample-app asserting a single enqueue when server returns 202.

mike: also bump sample-app request timeout from 10s to 25s to avoid client-side retry on expected slow metadata fetch.

qa-bot: latest CI run: sample-app-integration failed at 2148904000

harper: I'll open PRs: js-sdk#501 (mapping + tests + docs note) and js-sdk#502 (retry policy + integration test). tagging release owner @mike for cutoff.

mike: thanks — please include a changelog entry and a short note in sample-app README describing the flag and expected latency. I'll shepherd the merge.

eva: leaving this open until PRs merge and CI green. :thumbsup:
